faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.asideText: We collected the answers to the questions we hear most often. Didn’t find yours? Write to us.

cost.q: How much does a website cost?
cost.a: The cost depends on the scope. Landing page — from $1,400, corporate website — from $3,500, web app — from $8,700. We prepare an exact estimate after a short brief.

timeline.a: Landing page — 2 weeks, corporate website — 4–6 weeks, web app — from 8 weeks. Deadlines are fixed in the contract.

contract.q: Do you work under a contract?
contract.a: Yes, always. Contract + 50% prepayment. The balance is paid after project delivery. We work with both legal entities and individuals.

support.a: The first month is free: edits, consultations, and small improvements. After that — from $350/month or hourly billing.

update.q: Can you improve an existing website?
update.a: Yes, if the project is on Vue/Nuxt or another modern stack. We run an audit and propose a plan for improvements.
